Title: Operator
Comments: Good morning and welcome to the Acme Industrial third quarter 2019 earnings conference call. All participants will be in listen-only mode. A replay will be available on the company website.

Title: Vice President, Investor Relations
Comments: Thank you, operator. Before we begin, I remind you that today's remarks contain forward-looking statements that are subject to risks and uncertainties. With that, let me turn it over to our CEO, Sam Okafor.

Title: President and Chief Executive Officer
Comments: Thanks, Dana, and good morning everyone. I will cover the segment results and then Priya will cover the balance sheet. Revenue in the third quarter was $412 million, up 9% from the same quarter last year. Our aerospace segment grew for the sixth consecutive quarter. Utilization across our plants ran at 87% in the third quarter. Two years ago we launched the Falcon coating line, and it now accounts for a fifth of segment sales. We completed the Riverside expansion in 2018. We currently have three new plants under construction in Texas. We expect to complete the first of them in the second quarter of 2020. Last year we set a 2021 margin target of 18 percent. Given the momentum we saw in September, we are raising full-year guidance to $1.65 billion. Last year's restructuring is largely complete and we do not anticipate further charges. Cash flow from operations was $58 million in the quarter, up from $41 million a year ago, and we plan to return most of it to shareholders in 2020. Now let me hand it over to Priya to walk through the financials.

Title: Chief Financial Officer
Comments: Thank you, Sam. Gross margin was 31.4% in the third quarter compared to 29.8% in the prior-year period. We expect fourth quarter margins to be roughly flat sequentially.

Title: President and Chief Executive Officer
Comments: In summary, the quarter was strong and we remain confident in our 2020 targets. We will now open the line for questions.

Title: Operator
Comments: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Acme Industrial fourth quarter and full year 2019 earnings call.

Title: President and Chief Executive Officer
Comments: Good afternoon. Fourth quarter revenue was $431 million, a record for the company. For the full year, revenue came in at $1.66 billion, slightly ahead of the guidance we gave in October. The Dallas plant opened in December, roughly a quarter ahead of the schedule we set in 2018. Looking ahead, we expect 2020 revenue growth of 6% to 8%. Our backlog today stands at $2.1 billion. Over the past five years we have doubled the size of the aerospace business, and we believe that trajectory continues in 2020 and beyond. We also completed the Beacon acquisition in November and expect it to be accretive by the second half of 2020.

Title: Chief Financial Officer
Comments: Thanks, Sam. Operating cash flow for the year was $221 million. Capital expenditures will be approximately $90 million in 2020.

Title: Operator
Comments: Welcome to the Northwind Retail first quarter fiscal 2020 results conference call.

Title: Chief Executive Officer
Comments: Thank you and good morning. Comparable store sales increased 3.2% in the first quarter. This follows a 1.1% decline in the same quarter last year, so we are pleased with the turnaround. In March we closed 14 underperforming stores. We opened the Riverton store in February, and it is already ahead of plan. We now operate 612 stores across 31 states. Our e-commerce business, which we relaunched in 2018, grew 27% this quarter and we expect it to exceed 20% of sales by fiscal 2022. We are planning to open eight new stores in the second half of the year. Sales in April were the strongest month of the quarter. Marcus will walk through the details in a moment. Given the uncertainty in the current environment, we are withdrawing our full-year guidance. I want to thank our store teams for their work during the quarter.

Title: Chief Financial Officer
Comments: Thank you, Lena. Inventory at quarter end was $340 million, down 4% year over year. We expect inventory to decline further in the second quarter.

Title: Chief Executive Officer
Comments: With that, we are happy to take your questions.
